snippet.title: Pokémon Champions | Overview | Arriving 2026
snippet.description:
Get ready to experience everything you love about Pokémon battles all in one place—in Pokémon Champions!

This new, battle-focused game will feature familiar mechanics, two formats, three battle modes, and even the ability to bring over Pokémon through Pokémon HOME!

Find all your favorite Pokémon merchandise at the official Pokémon Center: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/
Official Site: https://www.pokemon.com
Instagram: http://www.instagram.com/pokemon
